transport_rule: Raw runner-stable PDF bytes use GitHub Actions -> immutable Release. Readable official webpages use claim-scoped visible-text capture -> bounded local database -> Google Drive. Transport does not change source authority and neither acquisition-time text extraction nor capture automatically promotes Evidence, Fact, Judgment or Reality.

fda_transport_diagnosis.finding: The historical FDA label and Drugs@FDA approval-package material were readable through interactive web retrieval, but repeated GitHub-hosted runner urllib retrieval returned stable 404 across both accessdata endpoint forms. Longcycle therefore preserves the 2020 approval/safety information through the official FDA readable-webpage lane rather than declaring the source missing or weakening the PDF gate.
fda_transport_diagnosis.do_not_do: Do not keep guessing accessdata URLs or describe the FDA source as unavailable. Do not put a fabricated raw-PDF identity into the Release pack.

evidence_boundary: This receipt proves durable source acquisition/capture and transport integrity only. Acquisition verification text, webpage capture text and Release/Drive transport do not themselves create publishable Evidence, Fact, Judgment, Reality or Outcome. Grounded Evidence must still persist claim-scoped documents/fragments and accept zero automatic Fact/Judgment promotion before CAP-0003/CAP-0004 projection.
